name: 杰克·基尔比
bio_short: 美国电气工程师，2000年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。他在德州仪器工作期间发明了世界上第一块集成电路（`integrated_circuit_1958`），一举解决了电子元件“数量的暴政”。此外，他还是手持电子计算器的发明者。
bio_short_en: An American electrical engineer and 2000 Nobel laureate in Physics. While working at Texas Instruments, he invented the world's first integrated circuit (`integrated_circuit_1958`), solving the 'Tyranny of Numbers' in electronics. He is also the inventor of the handheld electronic calculator.
